label: Synthetic household demo
scope: Static household and account proposals; no live operation or implementation
identityNote: Aliases label synthetic addresses; they do not introduce editable profiles, family relationships or recipe authorship.

household.roleNote: Administration and payment are separate responsibilities. All members retain recipe-editing permissions.

invite.state: New invitation created; link available in this immediate result
invite.delivery: No email has been sent. Share the link with the named recipient.
invite.capacity: Pending invitations do not reserve places.
invite.copyBeforeLeaving: Copy the link before leaving; it cannot be retrieved later.

join.fixtureNote: Email match and target-household facts are internal scenario preconditions, not a preview response or a verified invitation before acceptance.
visibleData: Masked pasted invitation link or code
Join action and its validation explanation
join.note: This is the recipient view before acceptance. Join checks the invitation, matching verified email, existing membership and capacity; the screen does not claim these checks have already succeeded.

account.leave: Alex must complete an accepted administration handover before leaving while other members remain.
account.deleteAccount: Opens a separate reauthentication and precise impact-preview flow; it does not immediately delete the account and must not require handover acceptance or subscription expiry.

create.stateRelationship: The same three-member household before Jordan's invitation is created
create.note: Creates a single-use invitation for the named email, then exposes its fresh link for manual sharing. It does not create a household or send an email.

unavailable.title: Invitation unavailable
unavailable.note: The filename identifies a design alternative; the UI does not claim the API diagnosed expiry. No membership change is shown.
recovery: Check your own signed-in email and existing membership
Review the pasted invitation link and retry
Ask the sender to check capacity or create a new link if expired or revoked

handover.note: Acceptance changes administration only. Authorship, payer, purchases and allowances remain unchanged; obsolete issuer invitations are revoked when the role actually changes.

effectsAfterConfirmation: Do not cancel or transfer a purchase
remove.exportLimit: Previously downloaded exports cannot be recalled.

constraints: Household and account are profile subflows, not a fourth main destination.
One active household membership per user; no household switcher.
Only the administrator creates or revokes invitations and removes other members.
Pending invitations grant no access, reserve no place and are not counted as members.
Never move member-only household data onto a pre-membership screen; verify each visible field against the available authenticated API response.
No invitation email delivery, resend status, read receipt or recoverable old link is implied.
Leaving, removing membership, deleting an account, administrator handover and payer replacement remain distinct.
Account deletion requires a future detailed preview design; handover is optional for deletion.
Native clients contain no external-checkout promotion.
No profile editing, household rename, final branding, new role or bulk household deletion is introduced.
No real invitation, purchase, account mutation or native test is performed by this packet.
T03, T09 and both readiness gates retain their existing status.
